moments.heading: CORTIS's first music show win
moments.body: CORTIS earned their first music show trophy with “REDRED” on April 30, 2026. The group won M Countdown with 8,902 points, and the broadcast included their first winning encore.

citations.title: Watch: CORTIS Takes 1st-Ever Win On M Countdown With REDRED

moments.heading: aespa's first music show win
moments.body: aespa earned their first music show trophy with “Black Mamba” on Inkigayo on January 17, 2021, without appearing on the show. Contemporary coverage reports that hosts Minhyuk, Naeun and Jaehyun filled in for the encore.

citations.title: aespa Takes 1st-Ever Win With Black Mamba On Inkigayo
aespa wins first place on Inkigayo without appearing
aespa earns first win with Black Mamba

moments.heading: BTS's first music show win
moments.body: BTS earned their first music show trophy with “I Need U” on May 5, 2015. Reflecting on their first week of wins, Jimin said the recognition made their practice feel worthwhile, while Suga described a new responsibility to keep improving.

citations.title: BTS Takes First-Ever Music Show Win on The Show
BTS Sincerely Open Up About the Meaning of Winning 1st on a Music Show

moments.heading: IVE's first music show win
moments.body: Just one week after debut, IVE won their first music show trophy with “ELEVEN” on Show Champion. Their first victory became an emotional moment for the group, captured in the broadcast's winner announcement and encore.

citations.title: IVE Takes Tearful 1st-Ever Win On Show Champion With ELEVEN

moments.heading: Red Velvet's first music show win
moments.body: Red Velvet won their first music show trophy with “Ice Cream Cake” on Music Bank, a day after finishing second on M Countdown. The members celebrated with a tearful acceptance speech and encore.

citations.title: Red Velvet Gets First-Ever Music Show Win on Music Bank
Red Velvet takes first music-show win

moments.heading: T-ara's first win in over five years
moments.body: “What's My Name” brought T-ara their first Korean music show win in over five years. Hyomin, Qri and Jiyeon cried on stage and struggled to give an acceptance speech. Eunjung later recalled crying when she heard the news by phone while filming a drama.

citations.title: T-ara Breaks Down After 1st Win For What's My Name
T-ara's Eunjung Talks About Emotional 1st Place Win

moments.heading: TWICE's first trophy came with tears
moments.body: TWICE won their first music-show trophy with “Cheer Up” on M Countdown on May 5, 2016. Jihyo looked back on the members’ appearance on SIXTEEN a year earlier, while the group cried through its acceptance speech.

citations.title: TWICE Sheds Tears At First Ever Win With Cheer Up On M!Countdown

moments.heading: TWICE followed its first win the next day
moments.body: One day after their M Countdown breakthrough, TWICE took a second trophy and its first Music Bank win with “Cheer Up” on May 6, 2016, scoring 8,079 points.

citations.title: TWICE Gets 2nd Win With Cheer Up On Music Bank

moments.pending_reason: The catalogue lists EXO’s Miracles in December win on 2014-01-02, while the contemporary M Countdown report dates that broadcast 2013-12-19. Confirm the catalogue date before publishing.
moments.heading: EXO kept its promise after the winter win
moments.body: A contemporary M Countdown report says EXO won with “Miracles in December” and then carried out a pre-announced promise to blow kisses to fans and the camera.

citations.title: EXO Wins at M!Countdown, Members Blow Kisses at Fans

moments.heading: EXO won Music Bank without performing
moments.body: EXO took the Music Bank trophy with “December, 2014 (The Winter’s Tale)” on January 2, 2015, even though the group did not perform on the programme.

citations.title: EXO Wins on Music Bank This Week With December 2014

moments.heading: SEVENTEEN's first win left the members in tears
moments.body: SEVENTEEN earned its first music-show trophy with “Pretty U” on Show Champion on May 4, 2016. The members became emotional during the win and encore after thanking fans, parents and staff.

citations.title: SEVENTEEN Tears Up Over 1st Ever Music Show Win On Show Champion For Pretty U

moments.heading: SEVENTEEN made it two in a row with Pretty U
moments.body: On May 11, 2016, SEVENTEEN won its second trophy for “Pretty U” on Show Champion. The report says the members were visibly thrilled and thanked fans, parents, staff and host Kim Shin Young.

citations.title: SEVENTEEN Takes 2nd Win For Pretty U On Show Champion

moments.heading: IU's self-written Friday opened the new year with a win
moments.body: IU won Music Bank on January 3, 2014 with “Friday,” a self-written and composed song from the Modern Times – Epilogue repackage. She was not actively promoting the song live, and EXO finished only ten points behind.

citations.title: IU Wins on Music Bank With Friday

moments.heading: Friday won again on Music Core
moments.body: The day after her Music Bank result, IU’s “Friday” also won on Music Core on January 4, 2014, overcoming songs by EXO and Brown Eyed Soul.

citations.title: IU's Friday Wins on Music Core

moments.heading: GFRIEND's first win arrived on Yerin's first regular week as MC
moments.body: GFRIEND won its first music-show No. 1 with “Rough” on The Show on February 2, 2016. The members cried while thanking fans, and the broadcast was also Yerin’s first week as a regular MC.

citations.title: GFRIEND Takes Home First Ever Music Show Win on The Show

moments.heading: GFRIEND followed its breakthrough with a second Rough win
moments.body: GFRIEND followed its first-ever trophy on The Show with a second “Rough” win on Show Champion on February 3, 2016. Each member had a chance to speak during the thank-you messages.

citations.title: GFRIEND Wins On Show Champion With Rough

moments.heading: BLACKPINK's debut song Whistle won on Inkigayo
moments.body: BLACKPINK earned its first Inkigayo trophy with debut song “Whistle” on August 21, 2016. The win arrived during the group’s debut promotions and was reported alongside the week’s winner announcement and stages.

citations.title: BLACKPINK Wins Inkigayo

moments.heading: BLACKPINK won M Countdown without a stage
moments.body: “Whistle” gave BLACKPINK its second trophy on September 8, 2016, when the group won M Countdown despite having no physical sales or performance on that episode.

citations.title: BLACKPINK Wins M Countdown With Whistle

moments.heading: (G)I-DLE reached its first trophy only weeks after debut
moments.body: (G)I-DLE won its first music-show trophy with “LATATA” on The Show on May 22, 2018, only a few weeks after debut. Jeon Soyeon promised the group would become idols worthy of the award.

citations.title: (G)I-DLE Takes 1st Ever Win With LATATA On The Show

moments.heading: LATATA's second trophy came on M Countdown
moments.body: Two days after its debut win, (G)I-DLE took a second “LATATA” trophy on M Countdown on May 24, 2018, beating WINNER’s “Everyday” by 8,183 to 7,394 points.

citations.title: (G)I-DLE Takes 2nd Win For LATATA On M Countdown

moments.heading: Stray Kids' first trophy with Miroh was emotional
moments.body: Stray Kids won its first music-show trophy with “MIROH” on M Countdown on April 4, 2019. The report describes the win as emotional and notes it came after the group’s debut the previous year.

citations.title: Stray Kids Takes Emotional 1st-Ever Music Show Win With Miroh

moments.heading: Stray Kids won Levanter on a no-performance M Countdown
moments.body: On December 19, 2019, M Countdown announced Stray Kids as the winner with “Levanter” even though that episode had no new performances. A video of the group thanking viewers was shown instead.

citations.title: Stray Kids Wins With Levanter On M Countdown

moments.heading: Apink's Mr. Chu win started with surprise
moments.body: Apink earned its first “Mr. Chu” music-show win on Show Champion on April 9, 2014. The members looked surprised during the announcement, with some close to tears, and Eunji posted a thank-you message afterward.

citations.title: A Pink Takes Their First Mr. Chu Win on Show Champion

moments.heading: Apink carried Mr. Chu to a second win
moments.body: Apink followed its Show Champion result with a second “Mr. Chu” win on M Countdown on April 10, 2014. The article also records that this was the group’s first M Countdown performance for the promotions.

citations.title: A Pink Wins on M Countdown This Week With Mr. Chu

moments.heading: ITZY won its first trophy nine days after debut
moments.body: ITZY won its first music-show trophy with “DALLA DALLA” on M Countdown on February 21, 2019, only nine days after debut. The group scored 8,527 points against Hwasa’s 7,882.

citations.title: ITZY Takes 1st Ever Win On M Countdown With DALLA DALLA

moments.heading: ITZY's second win was its first on a major network
moments.body: ITZY took its second “DALLA DALLA” win on Music Core on February 23, 2019. The 7,164-point result was also the rookie group’s first win on a major network music show.

citations.title: ITZY Takes 2nd Win For DALLA DALLA On Music Core

moments.heading: NCT Dream's first win was also The Show's 100th episode
moments.body: NCT Dream won its first music-show trophy with “My First and Last” on The Show on February 14, 2017. The episode was the programme’s 100th edition, and the members became teary during the encore.

citations.title: NCT Dream Takes 1st Ever Win With My First And Last On The Show

moments.heading: NCT Dream won My First and Last two weeks running
moments.body: NCT Dream took a second consecutive The Show trophy with “My First and Last” on February 21, 2017, scoring 8,248 points and beating fellow NCT unit NCT 127.

citations.title: NCT Dream Takes 2nd Win For My First And Last On The Show

moments.heading: Wanna One won within nine days of debut
moments.body: Wanna One won its first music-show trophy with “Energetic” on Show Champion on August 16, 2017, only nine days after debut. Every member had a chance to thank fans, and Ong Sung Woo said the result felt like a dream.

citations.title: Wanna One Takes 1st Ever Win With Energetic On Show Champion

moments.heading: Wanna One's second win came with a fan love letter
moments.body: Wanna One won a second “Energetic” trophy on M Countdown on August 17, 2017. The members followed their promise by holding placards that together read, “Since we’ve received a lot, there’s a lot we’re going to give too.”

citations.title: Wanna One Grabs 2nd Win For Energetic On M Countdown

moments.heading: MAMAMOO's first career win was tearful
moments.body: MAMAMOO earned its first career music-show win with “You’re The Best” on Inkigayo on March 6, 2016. The group edged Taeyeon’s “Rain” and Taemin’s “Press Your Number,” then thanked parents, its agency and fans through tears.

citations.title: MAMAMOO Takes 1st Career Music Show Win on Inkigayo

moments.heading: MAMAMOO followed its first win with another trophy
moments.body: MAMAMOO took its second music-show trophy for “You’re The Best” on Show Champion on March 9, 2016. The members thanked family, agency and fans again and posed with the trophy after the show.

citations.title: MAMAMOO Takes 2nd Win for You're The Best on Show Champion

moments.heading: BIGBANG's Loser began its win streak without the group present
moments.body: BIGBANG won Music Core with “Loser” on May 9, 2015. The group was not present for the broadcast, which nevertheless marked the first trophy of the song’s run.

citations.title: BIGBANG Takes Their First Win on Music Core With Loser

moments.heading: BIGBANG's Loser won again with Daesung as special MC
moments.body: The day after its Music Core breakthrough, BIGBANG won a second “Loser” trophy on Inkigayo on May 10, 2015, with 10,909 points. Daesung was also a special MC for the broadcast.

citations.title: BIGBANG Takes 2nd Music Show Win on Inkigayo

moments.heading: NCT 127 finally broke through with Cherry Bomb
moments.body: NCT 127 earned its first music-show win since debut with “Cherry Bomb” on M Countdown on June 22, 2017. The winning speech thanked Lee Soo Man, SM staff and NCTzens.

citations.title: NCT 127 Takes Their 1st Music Show Win Ever With Cherry Bomb

moments.heading: NCT 127 won Touch without accepting in person
moments.body: NCT 127’s “Touch” won The Show on March 27, 2018 with 8,500 points. The group could not accept the trophy in person because of its schedule.

citations.title: NCT 127 Takes 1st Win For Touch On The Show

moments.heading: LE SSERAFIM won Fearless eight days after debut
moments.body: LE SSERAFIM earned the first music-show trophy of its career with “FEARLESS” on The Show on May 10, 2022, eight days after debut. The group scored 8,456 points.

citations.title: LE SSERAFIM Takes 1st-Ever Win On The Show With FEARLESS

moments.heading: LE SSERAFIM took Fearless to Music Bank
moments.body: Three days after its first trophy, LE SSERAFIM won a second “FEARLESS” award on Music Bank on May 13, 2022, beating Lim Young Woong by 7,881 to 7,035 points.

citations.title: LE SSERAFIM Takes 2nd Win For FEARLESS On Music Bank

moments.heading: BTS's first public-broadcast win came with a parts-swapping encore promise
moments.body: BTS won Music Bank with “I Need U” on May 8, 2015, its first public-broadcast music-show trophy. Before the result, the members had promised to swap rapper and vocalist parts if they won.

citations.title: BTS's I Need U Wins First Place on Music Bank
BTS Sincerely Open Up About the Meaning of Winning 1st on a Music Show

moments.heading: aespa won with WDA featuring G-Dragon
moments.body: aespa won Music Bank with “WDA (Whole Different Animal)” on June 5, 2026. The broadcast report identifies the track as featuring BIGBANG’s G-Dragon and records a 6,934-point win.

citations.title: aespa Takes 1st Win For WDA (Whole Different Animal) On Music Bank

moments.heading: IVE followed its debut win with another ELEVEN trophy
moments.body: IVE won its second career music-show trophy with “ELEVEN” on The Show on December 14, 2021, scoring 7,376 points against ATEEZ and EVERGLOW.

citations.title: IVE Takes 2nd Win For ELEVEN On The Show

moments.heading: Red Velvet's Ice Cream Cake won again on Inkigayo
moments.body: Red Velvet followed its first Music Bank trophy with a second “Ice Cream Cake” win on Inkigayo on March 29, 2015. The group thanked SM Entertainment, its families and fans.

citations.title: Red Velvet Takes Second Music Show Win This Week on Inkigayo

moments.heading: ATEEZ’s first win came with Wave
moments.body: ATEEZ took its first-ever music-show trophy with “Wave” on M Countdown on June 20, 2019. Hongjoong said the group was happy and touched simply to be on stage each day, then thanked ATINY and the staff.

citations.title: ATEEZ Takes 1st Ever Win On M Countdown With Wave

moments.heading: ATEEZ edged out a close second Wave race
moments.body: Five days later, ATEEZ won “Wave” again on The Show with 6,207 points, only 17 points ahead of WJSN. The result was their second music-show trophy.

citations.title: ATEEZ Grabs 2nd Win For Wave On The Show

moments.heading: NewJeans received its first trophy without a live stage
moments.body: NewJeans earned its first music-show win with “Attention” on M Countdown on August 18, 2022. The summer-special broadcast did not have a live episode, so the group’s acceptance was shared by video.

citations.title: NewJeans Takes 1st-Ever Win With Attention

moments.heading: NewJeans followed Attention with a Music Bank win
moments.body: The next day, NewJeans won “Attention” again on Music Bank with 11,150 points, beating Girls’ Generation’s “FOREVER 1.” It was the group’s second trophy for the song.

citations.title: NewJeans Takes 2nd Win For Attention On Music Bank

moments.heading: Taeyeon’s solo debut won on Show Champion
moments.body: Taeyeon took her first solo music-show trophy with “I” on Show Champion on October 14, 2015. Contemporary coverage calls it her first win as a soloist and notes that she was not present at the broadcast.

citations.title: Girls’ Generation’s Taeyeon Takes First Win For I On Show Champion

moments.heading: I became Taeyeon’s first Music Core solo win
moments.body: On October 24, 2015, Taeyeon’s “I” won on Music Core. The report identifies it as the song’s seventh music-show victory and Taeyeon’s first solo win on that programme.

citations.title: Taeyeon Gets 7th Win For I On Music Core

moments.heading: GOT7’s first music-show win arrived nearly two years after debut
moments.body: GOT7 won its first music-show trophy with “If You Do” on The Show on October 6, 2015. The members thanked their agency, staff, fans and families, then held a short V Live celebration.

citations.title: GOT7 Takes First-Ever Music Show Win With If You Do

moments.heading: GOT7 made If You Do a three-week The Show run
moments.body: GOT7 won “If You Do” for the third consecutive week on The Show on October 20, 2015. Yugyeom was that day’s special MC, and the members thanked fans in four languages.

citations.title: GOT7 Takes Home Third Win For If You Do On The Show

moments.heading: TXT won Crown about a week after debut
moments.body: TXT earned its first music-show trophy with “Crown” on The Show on March 12, 2019, only about a week after debut. Soobin thanked fans and staff, while Beomgyu promised the group would keep improving.

citations.title: TXT Takes First Ever Win With Crown On The Show

moments.heading: TXT took a second Crown trophy on M Countdown
moments.body: Two days after its debut win, TXT took “Crown” to a second trophy on M Countdown with 7,612 points. The article describes it as the rookie group’s second-ever music-show win.

citations.title: TXT Grabs 2nd Win For Crown On M Countdown

moments.heading: The Boyz’s first win came when the members were away
moments.body: The Boyz won its first music-show trophy with “Bloom Bloom” on The Show on May 7, 2019. The members were unable to accept in person, so they shared photos and a thank-you video promising this was only the beginning.

citations.title: The Boyz Takes 1st Ever Win On The Show With Bloom Bloom

moments.heading: The Boyz’s Stealer win came on a Chuseok highlight special
moments.body: The Boyz won “The Stealer” on Show Champion on September 30, 2020. Because the episode was a Chuseok highlight special with no new performances, the group shared its thanks by video.

citations.title: The Boyz Wins With The Stealer On Show Champion

moments.heading: Girls’ Generation returned with a delayed Mr.Mr. win
moments.body: Girls’ Generation won “Mr.Mr.” on M Countdown on March 6, 2014 after album and music-video production problems had delayed the comeback. The members said they were grateful for fans’ consistent love and promised to repay it with good music.

citations.title: Girls’ Generation Takes Home Trophy With Mr.Mr. On M Countdown

moments.pending_reason: The catalogue records a Girls’ Generation Mr. Mr. Inkigayo win on 2014-03-09, but the researched contemporary article confirms only the comeback stage and the earlier M Countdown win. Find a direct winner report before publishing.
moments.heading: Mr. Mr. continued Girls’ Generation’s comeback week
moments.body: Girls’ Generation appeared on Inkigayo with “Mr. Mr.” on March 9, 2014 during the group’s comeback week. A direct report of the catalogue’s listed win is still needed.

citations.title: 2NE1 And Girls’ Generation Have Their Comeback Stages On Inkigayo

moments.heading: VIXX’s Eternity win brought a river of tears
moments.body: VIXX won “Eternity” on Inkigayo on June 8, 2014, beating Infinite and Gary and Jung In. The members cried through their thank-you speech while thanking Starlights, staff, parents and one another.

citations.title: VIXX’s 1st Win With Eternity On SBS Inkigayo

moments.heading: VIXX’s first Show Champion win followed Eternity
moments.body: Three days later, VIXX won “Eternity” on Show Champion. Contemporary coverage describes it as the group’s first win on that programme and says the members wiped away tears after the encore.

citations.title: VIXX Win Their Next Trophy On Show Champion With Eternity

moments.heading: SHINee’s View win landed two days after its seventh anniversary
moments.body: SHINee took its first “View” trophy on Show Champion on May 27, 2015, two days after the group’s seventh debut anniversary. The members said they had not expected the award and thanked SHINee World.

citations.title: SHINee Takes Home First Trophy For View On Show Champion

moments.heading: SHINee turned View into a second trophy
moments.body: SHINee won “View” again on M Countdown on May 28, 2015, making it the song’s second music-show win. The result came as the group’s comeback promotions continued across the weekly shows.

citations.title: SHINee’s 2nd Win With View Through M Countdown

moments.pending_reason: The catalogue’s earliest BEAST row is No More on 2014-06-21; the researched career-first Shock win is dated 2010-03-25 and has no matching catalogue row.
moments.heading: BEAST’s first trophy came with Shock
moments.body: Soompi reports that BEAST’s first music-show win was “Shock” on M Countdown on March 25, 2010, with members crying happy tears. The catalogue needs a matching 2010 row before this can publish.

citations.title: BEAST Gets First Music Show Win On M Countdown

moments.heading: BEAST opened Good Luck promotions with No More
moments.body: BEAST won Music Core with pre-release track “No More” on June 21, 2014, during the group’s special comeback stage for “Good Luck.” The same report notes that Taeyang finished second.

citations.title: BEAST Wins On Music Core This Week With Good Luck

moments.heading: iKON won My Type without music-show promotions
moments.body: iKON earned its first music-show win with “My Type” on Music Core on September 26, 2015, despite not promoting on music shows. Red Velvet and Fly to the Sky were the other contenders.

citations.title: iKON Gets Very 1st Win With My Type On Music Core

moments.heading: iKON’s second My Type win was a Chuseok special
moments.body: On September 27, 2015, iKON won “My Type” again on Inkigayo’s Chuseok special. Performances were prerecorded and the winner was announced online; the group scored 9,273 votes.

citations.title: iKON Takes 2nd Win For My Type On Chuseok Special Of Inkigayo

moments.heading: IZ*ONE thanked Produce 48’s national producers
moments.body: IZ*ONE won its first music-show trophy with “La Vie en Rose” on M Countdown on November 8, 2018. Leader Kwon Eun Bi thanked WIZ*ONE and the national producers from Produce 48, while Sakura promised they would keep working hard.

citations.title: IZ*ONE Takes 1st Ever Win On M Countdown With La Vie En Rose

moments.heading: IZ*ONE made La Vie en Rose two wins in five days
moments.body: Five days after its first trophy, IZ*ONE won “La Vie en Rose” on The Show with 8,918 points on November 13, 2018. MONSTA X and gugudan were the other nominees.

citations.title: IZ*ONE Takes 2nd Win For La Vie En Rose On The Show

moments.heading: WINNER won in its first week of debut promotions
moments.body: WINNER took its first music-show trophy with “Empty” on M Countdown on August 21, 2014, about a week after debut. The rookie group competed against Block B.

citations.title: WINNER Grabs First Music Show Win On M Countdown

moments.heading: WINNER took Empty to Music Bank
moments.body: WINNER won “Empty” on Music Bank on August 22, 2014, beating SISTAR for the episode’s top spot. It was the rookie group’s second music-show trophy in as many days.

citations.title: WINNER Win #1 + Performances From August 22nd Music Bank

moments.heading: ENHYPEN’s first trophy came after its first year
moments.body: ENHYPEN won its first music-show trophy with “Drunk-Dazed” on The Show on May 4, 2021. The 6,790-point result came roughly six months after the group’s debut.

citations.title: ENHYPEN Takes 1st-Ever Win On The Show With Drunk-Dazed

moments.heading: ENHYPEN made Drunk-Dazed two in a row
moments.body: ENHYPEN won “Drunk-Dazed” again on Show Champion on May 5, 2021. The report calls it the group’s second-ever music trophy and includes the full encore.

citations.title: ENHYPEN Earns 2nd Win For Drunk-Dazed On Show Champion

moments.heading: SISTAR opened its summer run with Touch My Body
moments.body: SISTAR won “Touch My Body” on M Countdown on July 31, 2014, beating INFINITE in the first-place nominees. The result opened the song’s summer music-show run.

citations.title: SISTAR Win #1 + Performances From July 31st M Countdown

moments.heading: Touch My Body kept SISTAR at No. 1
moments.body: SISTAR followed with a Music Bank win for “Touch My Body” on August 1, 2014. Contemporary coverage described the comeback track as a summer jam after the group’s long break.

citations.title: SISTAR Takes 1 On Music Bank

moments.heading: Kang Daniel’s first solo trophy was accepted by video
moments.body: Kang Daniel won his first solo music-show trophy with “What Are You Up To” on Music Bank on August 9, 2019. He was practicing at his agency rather than attending, so he posted a video thanking fans and promising better performances.

citations.title: Kang Daniel Takes 1st Win For What Are You Up To

moments.heading: Kang Daniel’s Touchin’ win was queried and confirmed
moments.body: Kang Daniel won “Touchin’” on The Show on December 3, 2019 with 6,195 points. After fans questioned the score, The Show and Gaon explained that the digital-data calculation was valid.

citations.title: The Show And Gaon Chart Confirm And Explain Kang Daniel’s Win

moments.heading: MONSTA X’s first win followed its first world tour
moments.body: MONSTA X won its first music-show trophy with “Dramarama” on The Show on November 14, 2017, after debuting in 2015. Shownu became too emotional to speak, and Jooheon said the group had won after its first world tour.

citations.title: MONSTA X Takes Emotional 1st Ever Win On The Show

moments.heading: MONSTA X’s Jealousy win became its second career trophy
moments.body: MONSTA X won “Jealousy” on The Show on April 17, 2018. The 7,550-point result was the group’s second-ever music-show win, ahead of EXID and The Boyz.

citations.title: MONSTA X Takes 1st Win For Jealousy On The Show

moments.heading: NMIXX’s first win came with Love Me Like This
moments.body: NMIXX earned its first music-show trophy with “Love Me Like This” on Show Champion on March 29, 2023. The members’ first win since debut was reported as a tearful one.

citations.title: NMIXX Takes Tearful 1st-Ever Win On Show Champion

moments.heading: NMIXX returned to the top with Dash
moments.body: NMIXX won “DASH” on Show Champion on January 24, 2024, one year after the group’s first trophy. The result opened the win run for the new title track.

citations.title: NMIXX Takes 1st Win For DASH On Show Champion

moments.heading: ZEROBASEONE won its debut trophy on The Show
moments.body: ZEROBASEONE took its first music-show trophy with debut song “In Bloom” on The Show on July 18, 2023, scoring 9,350 points. The result came during the group’s first week of promotions.

citations.title: ZEROBASEONE Takes 1st-Ever Win On The Show With In Bloom

moments.heading: ZEROBASEONE followed its debut win the next day
moments.body: The day after its debut trophy, ZEROBASEONE won “In Bloom” again on Show Champion on July 19, 2023. EXO, NMIXX, SHINee and Jungkook were among the nominees.

citations.title: ZEROBASEONE Takes 2nd Win For In Bloom On Show Champion

moments.heading: AKMU’s first award was posted online during the Sewol pause
moments.body: AKMU won its first live music-program award with “200%” on M Countdown on April 17, 2014. The episode was not broadcast out of respect for the Sewol ferry victims, so Mnet posted the result online.

citations.title: Akdong Musician’s M Countdown Win Posted Online Due To Sewol Ferry Tragedy

moments.pending_reason: The catalogue records an AKMU 200% Music Core win on 2014-04-19, but the located Soompi source covers M Countdown and later online announcements. Find a direct Music Core report before publishing.
moments.heading: AKMU’s 200% run continued while shows were suspended
moments.body: AKMU’s “200%” is listed in the catalogue as a Music Core win on April 19, 2014 during the Sewol broadcast suspension. A direct report for that listed event is still needed.

citations.title: Akdong Musician Wins 1st Place For Third Week In A Row On M Countdown

moments.heading: EXID’s viral fancam revival finally produced a win
moments.body: EXID won its first music-show trophy with “Up & Down” on M Countdown on January 8, 2015. The song had been released months earlier, then surged after performance fancams went viral; staff delivered the trophy to the group’s practice room.

citations.title: EXID Wins First Ever Music Show On M Countdown

moments.heading: EXID’s first on-stage trophy came at Music Bank
moments.body: EXID won “Up & Down” on Music Bank on January 9, 2015. Because the previous day’s M Countdown result was not a live broadcast, this was the first time the members received the trophy on stage.

citations.title: EXID Wins On Music Bank With Up & Down

moments.heading: G-Dragon won Untitled, 2014 without promoting it on shows
moments.body: G-Dragon’s “Untitled, 2014” won Music Core on June 17, 2017. The song was competing with SISTAR and TWICE, and the win came even though he had not promoted the track on music shows.

citations.title: G-Dragon Grabs 1st Win With Untitled, 2014 On Music Core

moments.heading: Untitled, 2014 won again with Mark as special MC
moments.body: G-Dragon took a second trophy for “Untitled, 2014” on Inkigayo on June 18, 2017. NCT’s Mark served as special MC for the episode while G-Dragon’s song topped the chart.

citations.title: G-Dragon Gets 2nd Win With Untitled, 2014 On Inkigayo

moments.heading: ILLIT’s Magnetic became a first-week trophy
moments.body: ILLIT won its first music-show trophy with “Magnetic” on The Show on April 2, 2024, scoring 6,904 points. The members became emotional during the first win.

citations.title: ILLIT Takes Tearful 1st-Ever Win On The Show With Magnetic

moments.heading: ILLIT’s Magnetic win doubled the following week
moments.body: ILLIT won “Magnetic” again on The Show on April 9, 2024, with 8,990 points. The result was the group’s second music-show trophy.

citations.title: ILLIT Takes 2nd Win For Magnetic On The Show

moments.heading: INFINITE’s Last Romeo win came with a fan promise
moments.body: INFINITE won “Last Romeo” on Show Champion on May 28, 2014. L had promised that Sungyeol and Dongwoo would dress as Romeo and Juliet if the song won, turning the trophy into a playful encore challenge.

citations.title: Infinite Wins This Week’s Show Champion For Last Romeo

moments.heading: INFINITE’s second Last Romeo win became a Juliet transformation
moments.body: INFINITE won “Last Romeo” again on M Countdown on May 29, 2014. Dongwoo completed the promised gag by putting on red lipstick and transforming into Juliet for the encore.

citations.title: Infinite Takes Home Second Win With Last Romeo On M Countdown

moments.heading: Oh My Girl’s first win came 1,009 days after debut
moments.body: Oh My Girl earned its first music-show win with “Secret Garden” on The Show on January 23, 2018, 1,009 days after debut. The members thanked Miracle, their parents, staff and one another through tears.

citations.title: Oh My Girl Takes 1st Ever Win With Secret Garden On The Show

moments.heading: Secret Garden won again the next day
moments.body: The day after its breakthrough, Oh My Girl took a second “Secret Garden” trophy on Show Champion. In an interview, the members said they had focused on growing with every album and never stopped being grateful simply to perform.

citations.title: Oh My Girl Opens Up About 1st Music Show Win And Success Of Secret Garden

moments.heading: STAYC’s Stereotype ended its first year with a first win
moments.body: STAYC won its first music-show trophy with “STEREOTYPE” on The Show on September 14, 2021, less than a year after debut. The group scored 8,760 points and accepted the award through tears.

citations.title: STAYC Takes Tearful 1st-Ever Win On The Show With STEREOTYPE

moments.heading: STAYC won Stereotype again on a replay-special episode
moments.body: STAYC’s “STEREOTYPE” won Show Champion on September 15, 2021. The episode used replayed performances instead of a normal live broadcast, and the group’s second trophy was announced at the end.

citations.title: STAYC Takes 2nd Win For STEREOTYPE On Show Champion

moments.heading: Highlight’s first win under its new name was Plz Don’t Be Sad
moments.body: Highlight won “Plz Don’t Be Sad” on The Show on March 28, 2017, its first music-show trophy under the new name after leaving BEAST behind. The group marked the moment with a performance-version video after the win.

citations.title: Highlight Celebrates Views Milestone With Performance Version Of Plz Don’t Be Sad

moments.heading: Highlight made Plz Don’t Be Sad two wins in two days
moments.body: Highlight won a second “Plz Don’t Be Sad” trophy on Show Champion on March 29, 2017. The report identifies it as the group’s second win for the new hit track.

citations.title: Highlight Wins 2nd Trophy For Plz Don’t Be Sad On Show Champion

moments.heading: fromis_9’s first win arrived after a four-year wait
moments.body: fromis_9 won its first music-show trophy with “Talk & Talk” on The Show on September 7, 2021, after debuting in 2018. The group scored 8,470 points and celebrated an emotional first win.

citations.title: fromis_9 Takes Tearful 1st-Ever Win On The Show With Talk & Talk

moments.heading: fromis_9 returned quickly with a second win for DM
moments.body: fromis_9 won “DM” on The Show on January 25, 2022, its second overall music-show trophy after “Talk & Talk.” The members thanked Flover with messages written in sketchbooks during the encore.

citations.title: fromis_9 Takes First Win For DM On The Show

moments.heading: Jungkook’s solo debut won on M Countdown
moments.body: Jungkook earned his first solo music-show trophy with “Seven” on M Countdown on July 20, 2023, scoring 6,068 points over NewJeans’ “Super Shy.” The episode also marked Joohoney’s last day as MC.

citations.title: Jungkook Takes 1st Win For Seven On M Countdown

moments.heading: Seven became Jungkook’s second trophy the next week
moments.body: Jungkook won “Seven” again on M Countdown on July 27, 2023, with 7,606 points. NewJeans’ “Super Shy” was the other first-place nominee.

citations.title: Jungkook Takes 2nd Win For Seven On M Countdown

moments.heading: BOYNEXTDOOR’s first trophy came with But Sometimes
moments.body: BOYNEXTDOOR took its first-ever music-show trophy with “But Sometimes” on The Show on September 12, 2023, scoring 9,080 points. The result was the group’s first win since debut.

citations.title: BOYNEXTDOOR Takes 1st-Ever Win On The Show With But Sometimes

moments.heading: BOYNEXTDOOR doubled its first win on Show Champion
moments.body: BOYNEXTDOOR won “But Sometimes” again on Show Champion on September 13, 2023, its second career music-show trophy. The nominees included AKMU, RIIZE, BTS’s V and MAMAMOO’s Hwasa.

citations.title: BOYNEXTDOOR Takes 2nd Win For But Sometimes On Show Champion
